relations: The floating ice shard reorients in place, causing its upper tip to droop rightward while the right end rises.
As the shard turns, the bright sky-reflection shifts shape and spreads from the right half toward the upper edge.
A thin strand of ice and water persists hanging from the shard's lower notch in the middle-to-late frames.
Ripples and bubbles on the left jitter and rearrange, while faint sky reflections appear in the adjacent open water.
caption: The video captures a close, top-down view of a wet grey concrete surface holding a shallow puddle, in which a single flat, arrowhead-shaped piece of clear ice floats. The shard's right half mirrors bright sky, while the water to its left is darker and dotted with small bubbles and grit. Over the excerpt the shard's orientation shifts gradually in place, its upper tip drooping downward and toward the right while the pointed right end rises, so the piece reorients rather than drifting across the scene. As it turns, the bright reflected highlight shifts shape and spreads from the right half toward the upper edge. A thin strand of ice and water hangs from the shard's lower notch in the middle-to-late frames. Small ripples and bubbles on the left jitter and rearrange, and faint white sky-reflection patches appear in the open water beside the shard.
